title = Infantry: Anti-Tank Rifle
20mhit = 20 m target hit! 50mhit = 50 m target hit! 100mhit = 100 m target hit! Good shooting. 200mhit = 200 m target hit! Well done! 500mhit = 500 m target hit! Excellent! gunrange = Firing Line vehiclerange = Vehicle Target Range truckhit = You hit the truck! carhit = You hit the armored car! tankhit = You hit the tank!
1.0.label = The Anti-Tank Rifle
1.1.label = Intro 1.1.alert.modal = An anti-tank rifleman is equipped with a high power, low rate of fire rifle used primarily for disabling trucks and armored vehicles. Stealth, strategy, and accuracy are crucial for success against enemy vehicles.
1.2.label = Firing Position 1.2.alert = Move forward to the firing line. #waypoint label: "Firing Line" #waypoint: -314046.54,3603720.08,101.73
1.3.label = Sidearm 1.3.alert = While the Anti-Tank Rifle does have the fire power to easily eliminate an enemy infantry threat, the low rate of fire and need to deploy the weapon puts the anti-tank rifleman at a distinct disadvantage in close-quarters combat. Fortunately, the anti-tank rifleman is equipped with a sidearm to level the playing field. Press {fpweapon1} to wield your pistol.
1.4.label = Firing the Sidearm 1.4.alert = Take a moment to practice firing your sidearm at the targets by pressing {fpfire}.
2.0.label = Vehicle Targets
2.1.label = Vehicle Target Range 2.1.alert = Move to the Vehicle Target Range to practice firing your Anti-Tank Rifle. #waypoint label "Vehicle Target Range" #waypoint: -313969.40,3603763.17,100.32
2.2.label = Equip the Anti-Tank Rifle 2.2.alert = Equip your Anti-Tank Rifle with {fpweapon0}
2.3.label = Deploying the Anti-Tank Rifle 2.3.alert = Like the Light Machinegun, the Anti-Tank Rifle must be deployed on the ground or a solid surface to fire. Move up to the sand bags and deploy the Anti-Tank Rifle by pressing {fpdeploy}.
2.4.label = Damaging Vehicles 2.4.alert = After the previous tutorials you should now be comfortable estimating the distance to your target and setting your gunsite range. The Anti-Tank Rifle requires precision and is most effective from a range of less than 200 meters. This makes the Anti-Tank Rifle more practical for urban combat than fighting vehicles in open fields. Practice firing your rifle into the nearby vehicles with {fpfire}.
2.5.label = Vehicle Weak Spots 2.5.alert.modal = Anti-Tank Rifles can only penetrate thin armor on vehicles. Fortunately, this is enough to eliminate many vehicle crewmembers and critical components. This is often enough to disable or completely destroy enemy vehicles.
content.brief: Learn how to operate an anti-tank rifle.
